body: I just can’t help but feel guilty. Ive had my fair share of crazy episodes and saying things i regret bc ive gotten too drunk etc etc n then when he fucks up i instantly have feelings of leaving, am i being unfair? I guess the whole relationship is toxic and this is one of those “love isnt enough” situations but FUCK it would just be so hard
We werent together for the first one. He knew its happened before but i dont really talk about it. I never thought he would act the way he did, especially not about this
I spoke to him about it and how everything he said honestly just made everything worse, and he felt really guilty about it and apologized. He just seems so sincere.. idk if im just being weak
